name: pod-data
description: Pod Data is an unofficial checklist for tracking your completion progress in NieR: Automata. Mark various items, quests, and achievements as completed, to help keep track of what you've done and what still needs to be accomplished.

scripts.supabase:types: npx supabase gen types typescript > app/types/database.types.ts
scripts.supabase:types:prod: node -e "require('dotenv').config({path:'.env.prod'});require('dotenv').config({path:'.env'});if (!process.env.SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID) throw new Error('SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID is required');require('child_process').execSync('npx supabase gen types typescript --schema public --remote='+process.env.SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID+' > app/types/database.types.ts',{stdio:'inherit',shell:true})"
